ValidationRule.description: Once the Opp is closed only admin can modify the Opp Product.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "A - RevOps", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> 'Workato', ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK (Opportunity.Date_100__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can't Modify Product after Opp is Won. See Admin for help.
